items.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces 'ChatGPT Work'
items.title_zh: OpenAI 获政府批准发布 GPT-5.6，同时推出 ChatGPT Work
items.summary: OpenAI received Trump administration approval for the public release of GPT-5.6, following a limited preview restricted to government-approved organizations. CEO Sam Altman called it 'the best model we have ever produced.' The company also announced ChatGPT Work, integrating Codex agent capabilities and hosted sites.

items.title: Humanoid robots controlled by surgeons did world-first operation on live pigs
items.title_zh: 人形机器人由外科医生遥控，完成全球首例活猪手术
items.summary: A preclinical trial demonstrated humanoid robots performing surgery on live pigs under surgeon control, testing the feasibility of humanoid robots in surgical settings for the first time.

items.title: Fidji Simo steps down from leading OpenAI's AGI work due to illness
items.title_zh: Fidji Simo 因健康原因辞去 OpenAI AGI 负责人职务
items.summary: OpenAI's AGI chief Fidji Simo is departing her full-time role and transitioning to part-time advisor, following a medical leave for a neuroimmune condition announced in April. The leadership gap comes as OpenAI considers an IPO and races to catch Anthropic in enterprise.

items.title: Blue Origin seeks to raise $10 billion in outside capital
items.title_zh: 蓝色起源拟融资 100 亿美元，寻求首批外部投资
items.summary: Blue Origin plans to raise $10 billion in the company's first outside investment round to support its launch services and satellite constellation ambitions.

items.title: New York Times says OpenAI hid evidence in ChatGPT copyright trial
items.title_zh: 纽约时报指控 OpenAI 在版权案中隐瞒证据
items.summary: News publishers filed a motion for sanctions against OpenAI, alleging the company hid tools and datasets that could identify copyrighted journalism in ChatGPT outputs and deleted billions of training logs.

items.title: Meta enters the crowded AI coding battle with Muse Spark 1.1
items.title_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Spark 1.1 加入 AI 编程竞争
items.summary: Meta released Muse Spark 1.1, an AI coding model designed to handle large agentic workloads, fix bugs, and assist with large-scale code migrations for enterprise customers.

items.title: Anthropic found a hidden space where Claude puzzles over concepts
items.title_zh: Anthropic 发现 Claude 内部隐藏的推理空间
items.summary: Anthropic developed a technique called the Jacobian lens that provides the clearest glimpse yet into how large language models process concepts internally. The findings range from mundane to unnerving, offering unprecedented interpretability.

items.title: OpenAI launches its new family of models with GPT-5.6
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 系列模型
items.summary: OpenAI's latest family of models promises improvements across multiple areas including cybersecurity, with GPT-5.6 continuing to power Microsoft Copilot 365.

items.title: OpenAI is shutting down Atlas, but its AI browser ambitions are still growing
items.title_zh: OpenAI 关停 Atlas 浏览器，但 AI 浏览器野心仍在
items.summary: OpenAI is sunsetting ChatGPT Atlas, its AI-powered browser, less than a year after launch. Agentic browsing features are being moved to the desktop app and a Chrome extension instead.

items.title: Meta's new AI chips will begin production in September
items.title_zh: Meta 自研 AI 芯片将于九月投产
items.summary: Meta is taking a modular approach to designing its own AI chips, anticipating rapidly evolving AI needs by the time the chips enter production in September.

items.title: Nvidia is a victim of the compute marketplace it created
items.title_zh: 英伟达成为自创算力市场的受害者
items.summary: Having proven the value of compute, Nvidia now finds itself at the center of a market everyone wants to enter, while simpler technologies profit on the sidelines.

items.title: Paris-based AI voice startup Gradium raises $100M seed, backed by Nvidia
items.title_zh: 巴黎 AI 语音初创 Gradium 获 1 亿美元种子轮，英伟达参投
items.summary: Gradium, a Paris-based AI voice startup, raised $100 million in seed funding backed by Nvidia to open a Bay Area office and compete for talent.

items.title: Mercor is in talks for a $20B valuation
items.title_zh: Mercor 正洽谈 200 亿美元估值融资
items.summary: AI-powered hiring platform Mercor is in talks for a $20 billion valuation, doubling from its $10 billion valuation reached in October 2025.

items.title: An AI agent startup just let its agent run its $100M fundraise
items.title_zh: AI Agent 初创用自家代理完成 1 亿美元融资
items.summary: Lyzr, an enterprise AI agent startup, used its own AI agent to run a $100 million fundraising round as proof that the product works.

items.title: Google might rebrand Pixel Magic Cue as Gemini 'Proactive Assistance'
items.title_zh: 谷歌拟将 Pixel Magic Cue 更名为 Gemini 主动助手
items.summary: Google is planning to rebrand the Pixel Magic Cue feature, which proactively surfaces relevant info, under the Gemini umbrella as 'Proactive Assistance.'

items.title: Google asks for Gemini app feedback & details top 10 requests
items.title_zh: 谷歌征求 Gemini 用户反馈，公布十大需求
items.summary: Google's Gemini lead Josh Woodward identified the top 10 user-requested fixes for the Gemini app and detailed the team's progress on each.

items.title: Report: Apple interested in startup that runs giant AI models on iPhone without servers
items.title_zh: 消息称苹果有意投资在 iPhone 本地运行大模型的初创公司
items.summary: The Information reports Apple may invest in PrismML, a startup focused on shrinking AI models to run on-device with comparable intelligence to server-based models.

items.title: Instagram users: Here's how to stop Meta's AI from using your photos
items.title_zh: 如何阻止 Meta AI 使用你的 Instagram 照片
items.summary: Meta's new Muse Image feature allows users to generate AI images using photos from public Instagram accounts by default, raising privacy concerns. Users can disable this via two hidden toggles.

items.title: Claude AI may ask you if you're using it too much
items.title_zh: Anthropic 测试 Claude 过度使用提醒功能
items.summary: Anthropic is beta-testing a feature that prompts Claude users to reflect on their AI usage patterns and consider using the assistant less.

items.title: New bill would ban Tesla's camera-only Robotaxi, not Waymo
items.title_zh: 新泽西州提案禁特斯拉纯视觉 Robotaxi，Waymo 不受影响
items.summary: New Jersey lawmakers advanced a bill requiring driverless vehicles to carry cameras plus two additional sensor types, effectively locking out Tesla's camera-only Robotaxi unless it adds radar and lidar.

items.title: Free Waymo rides in California? You can thank a regulatory quirk
items.title_zh: 加州监管漏洞致 Waymo 可能免费提供服务
items.summary: A California state agency's delay in processing permits could result in Waymo offering free robotaxi rides in its new Ojai vehicle for several months.

items.title: Insta360 unveils vision for AI-powered Cameraman robot on 11th anniversary
items.title_zh: 影石 Insta360 发布 AI 摄影师机器人概念
items.summary: Insta360 marked its 11th anniversary by unveiling the Cameraman concept, an AI agent capable of autonomous filming using panoramic drones as early prototypes.

items.title: Apple's iPhone Ultra initial China inventory estimated at around one million units
items.title_zh: 苹果折叠屏 iPhone Ultra 首批中国备货约一百万台
items.summary: Apple's first foldable iPhone Ultra has entered mass production, with Foxconn reportedly beginning large-scale hiring. The first China-market batch is estimated at just over one million units, lower than previous flagship launches.

items.title: Porsche's first-half deliveries fall 16%, China sales plunge nearly one-third
items.title_zh: 保时捷上半年全球交付量下降 16%，中国销量暴跌近三成
items.summary: Porsche delivered 122,306 vehicles worldwide in H1 2026, down 16% YoY, driven by challenging Chinese market conditions and the expiration of US EV tax credits.

items.title: DJI launches AP100 parachute system for Matrice 400 enterprise drone
items.title_zh: 大疆推出 Matrice 400 无人机降落伞系统 AP100
items.summary: DJI launched the AP100 Parachute, its first parachute system for enterprise drone applications, designed for the Matrice 400 at a price of 7,488 yuan (~$1,100).
